blocks.text:
Take an early transfer to the airport and fly to the region. On arrival, you’ll be met and driven to the estate, where you’ll check in and have lunch.

Los Llanos, the vast savannas of central Venezuela, is a wildlife sanctuary. It is home to around 350 bird species and 50 species of mammals. Many birds fly here from Canada and Alaska for the winter.

Over these days, you’ll explore by land and water with professional local guides. Set out on an excursion in the afternoon, with a chance to see Orinoco crocodiles, caimans, capybaras, several species of anteater, red howler monkeys, tapirs, sloths and local deer. If you’re lucky, you might spot an ocelot or a puma. The outing includes traditional fishing for red-eyed piranha (Caribe Ojo Rojo) from a boat or from the riverbank. Return for dinner.

You can also book an optional night safari in Los Llanos.

Meals: light breakfast, lunch and dinner.
